data.body: 2026-10-02 task 178 (finished): compaction summary-share default lowered 38.2% -> 20%; the Settings label is now "Summary share of compaction (%)". Supersedes the "summary 0.382" figure in the project-memory summary and the design markdown (saved via Adashi: ratio 0.8:0.2; 100k R 10,080/S 2,520, 262k 42,509/10,627, 1M 199,796/49,948, 32k floor 2,097/524).
